paper_overview.ncert_enough: Haan — RBSE Class 10 English syllabus purely NCERT ke First Flight aur Footprints Without Feet par based hai. Dono books thoroughly padho, extra material zyada zaroori nahi.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 10 English mein 7 main question types: MCQ (1), Fill Blank grammar (1), VSA (1), SA 20-30 words (2), Writing tasks 100 words (4), Long Answer 60 words (3), Sentence transformation (1).

types.mostly_from: No negative marking — sab attempt karo, confused ho toh bhi best guess lagao.
Verb form + tense agreement — rules clear hon toh sure-shot marks.
Direct answer — passage se uthake likho, paraphrase ki zarurat nahi.
2-3 full sentences. Point + brief explanation. Each 2 marks.
Format (letter/email), title+moral (story), hints cover karna (paragraph). Content + language alag alag graded.
Character analysis, plot interpretation, theme explanation. 4-5 sentences. Textual examples include karo.

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: English overall aasaan subject hai agar NCERT books thoroughly padhi hain. Grammar + writing ratne se full marks milte hain. Textbook long answers mein sochke likhna padta hai.
most_scoring_sections: Easy — vocabulary + direct passage questions. Good reading speed chahiye bas.
Easy to Medium — formats yaad hain toh writing aasaan. Creativity zyada nahi chahiye.
Easy — pure rule-based, practice kiya toh 10/10 pakka.

tips: Section D = 42 marks — textbook thoroughly padho, aadha paper yahin se aata hai
Grammar 10 marks — rules clear hon toh full marks aate hain, daily practice karo
Writing format marks alag hote hain — email format galat = direct 1-2 marks cut
Story mein title aur moral dono COMPULSORY — bhoologe toh marks cut
Unseen passage mein vocabulary (similar/opposite) pakke 4 marks — pehle attempt karo
The Proposal drama — Lomov ka character, Chubukov ki suspicion, Natalya ki ziddiyat — ye Q14 mein confirmed aata hai
Footprints Q20 (5 MCQ) — easy 5 marks agar basic plot + characters yaad hain
Handwriting clear rakho — unclear writing = checker irritate = kam marks
Word limits follow karo — 100 words = 90-110 range, 60 words = 55-65 range, 20-30 words = 25 target
Answer sheet pe question numbers aur set number likhna COMPULSORY
Reading time mein OR options dekh lo — strongest wala choose karo
No negative marking — sab MCQ attempt karo, chhodna nahi

time_allocation.note: 15 min reading time — dono unseen passages ek baar padh lo, writing topic choose karo, Section D ke OR options mein se strong chapter pick karo.
2 passages × ~17 min. Pehle passage jaldi padho, phir questions. Vocabulary (similar/opposite) first attempt karo — quick scoring.
3 writing tasks × 10 min. Email/Letter (10) + Story (10) + Paragraph (10). Format galat = marks cut.
10 grammar questions × 2 min. Tenses pe zyada focus, ek-ek answer double-check karo.
42 marks ka section — 85 min mein. Prose extract (10) + Prose SA/LA (20) + Poetry (20) + Footprints (25). Writing fast + clear karo.
Format check (email/letter), tense errors fix karo, spelling galtiyaan check karo, word limits verify karo.

targets.strategy: Section A easy 10+, Section C 6-7, Writing 6-7, Section D selective 5+. Total ~28-30 aasaan.
focus_areas: Section A vocabulary questions (similar/opposite) — pakke 4 marks
Grammar Section C — Tenses + Subject-Verb rules ratke 7-8 marks
Writing Section B — kisi ek format (email format sabse structured) mein expert bano
Footprints Q20 (5 MCQ) — 9 lessons ke basic facts yaad karo
Section D MCQs (prose + poetry extracts) — 5-6 aasaan marks
chapters_to_skip_safely: Section D Long Answers (60 words) — attempt nahi kiya toh chalega

targets.strategy: Section A full (14-16) + Section B full (9-10) + Section C full (8-9) + Section D selective (18-20). Total 50-55.
focus_areas: Reading passages — speed reading practice + vocabulary confidence
Writing: email format + story structure + paragraph template ratke
Textbook: First Flight prose thoroughly + Footprints top 5-6 lessons

targets.strategy: Sab sections mein high scoring. Section D mein 30+ marks target karo.
focus_areas: All First Flight prose lessons — character sketches, themes, key events
All 10 poems — themes, literary devices (metaphor, personification), central idea
All Footprints lessons — for MCQ + SA + LA
The Proposal drama — Lomov, Chubukov, Natalya ki full character analysis
Writing: all 3 formats practice karo — letter + story + paragraph

targets.strategy: Sab 20 questions mein maximum marks. Handwriting + presentation + grammar errors zero.
extra_focus_areas: Previous 5 years ke RBSE papers solve karo — topics repeat hote hain
Writing mein original ideas + advanced vocabulary (synonyms, idioms) use karo
Section D long answers (60 words) mein textual evidence + thoughtful interpretation
Poetry mein literary devices name karke explain karo (metaphor, personification, alliteration, imagery)
Grammar 10/10 pakka — har rule ke 5+ examples solve karo

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 15 minute reading time milta hai — is time mein sirf paper padho, answer sheet pe kuch likhna allowed nahi.

answer_sheet_rules: reading_time_note: 15 min reading time mein sirf paper padho — answer sheet pe kuch bhi mat likhna.
sequence_note: Order mein likhna zaroori nahi — lekin har question ke parts (i, ii, iii) continuity mein likho.
word_limit_note: Word limit follow karo — over-writing se extra marks NAHI milte, time waste hota hai.
mcq_attempt_all: No negative — sare 15+ MCQs attempt karo
content_vs_language: Writing tasks mein content + language alag graded. Grammar errors minimize karo.
format_marks: Email/Letter mein format ke dedicated marks — galat format = 1-2 marks cut.
spelling_count: Major spelling mistakes se marks cut hote hain — specially in writing section.

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: English paper mein diagram nahi aata — sab pen se likho. note: Ek color throughout. Red pen sirf examiner use karta hai.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: handwriting: Clear aur legible. Cursive ya print — koi bhi, par readable hona chahiye. margin: Left side margin leave karo — examiner comments likhta hai cutting: Single line se cut karo, scribbling mat karo. Whitener/fluid allowed nahi. paragraph_breaks: Letter/email/story/paragraph mein proper indentation + line gap. partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: Long answers mein agar poora nahi likh paye, jo likha hai uske partial marks milte hain. writing_format_marks: Email/Letter: Format = 1 mark, Content = 2 marks, Language = 1 mark (approx split).
